player_prompt.intro:
Aalen Mastermind khelena.
Aapni {code_length} angka lamba code khojna darkar, pratyek angka 1 theke {num_numbers} porjonto, {repeats}.
Aapni jawab me, aapni anuman ko ei format me jama kar sakten: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Pratyek anuman pore, aapni kalo ar safed peg rup me pratikriya paben.
Kalo peg sahi angka sahi sthane ke bare me janaben, jabki safed peg sahi angka bhul sthane ke bare me janaben.
Aapnake {max_turns} pala ache code khojnar jonne.
